decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using Jund colors, utilizing powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps to generate additional threats while cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes complementary pieces like Mishra's Research Desk and Haywire Mite to enhance its overall strategy. Additionally, the use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional consistency and flexibility in deckbuilding.

The main theme of this deck is to control the game through removal spells and disruptive creatures while also generating value through card advantage and powerful planeswalkers. The deck aims to establish board control by utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding, while also being able to finish off opponents quickly with powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. By managing the opponent's resources and maintaining a strong board presence, this deck can outvalue and outmaneuver its opponents to secure victory.

This Modern UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents' game plans. Utilizing cards like Expressive Iteration, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure, while also running countermagic like Spell Snare and Counterspell to protect our creatures and disrupt the opponent's plays. Removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt help to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo, overwhelming the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and efficient creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence. The deck combines various colors to take advantage of diverse removal options and versatile threats. Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and tempo advantage, while Omnath, Locus of Creation acts as a powerful finisher. Leyline Binding and Prismatic Ending handle threats efficiently, while Fury and Solitude provide additional removal options. The inclusion of Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Nissa, Resurgent Animist adds extra utility and resilience to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip Colossus Hammer and other equipments onto creatures like Ornithopter and Inkmoth Nexus to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. The deck relies heavily on cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Sigarda's Aid to enable the equipment strategy efficiently. Additionally, cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce provide some control elements to protect the combo. The deck also includes Urza's Saga to tutor for artifacts and lands like Inkmoth Nexus.

This deck focuses on early game disruption and aggression, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, Ragavan, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's strategy and apply pressure. It also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. The deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while maintaining control of the board through a combination of creature threats and hand disruption. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allow for additional value and versatility in combat situations.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive threats like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Grief. It also utilizes countermagic like Counterspell to protect its threats and control the game. The deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember to deal with opposing threats. It combines elements of aggro, control, and disruption to apply pressure while keeping the opponent off balance.?m

This deck focuses on using various counterspells and removal spells to control the board and protect key cards, including The One Ring, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Murktide Regent. The main goal is to out value the opponent through card advantage and powerful threats. Utilizing a mix of permission, removal, and powerful creatures, this control deck aims to establish dominance and take over the game in the mid to late game stages. The inclusion of powerful planeswalker-like enchantments and unique creatures make it a versatile and formidable control archetype.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a lot of mana quickly and cast powerful spells and creatures like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also includes control elements like Warping Wail and Oblivion Stone to deal with threats from opponents. The deck's main strategy is to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats once the Tron lands are assembled. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional source of mana to help ramp into the deck's high-cost spells.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats. By cascading into impactful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Subtlety adds flexibility to the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outpace the opponent and control the board with its efficient spells.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to utilize efficient creatures and spells to apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The deck also includes card selection spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to ensure a consistent stream of threats. Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide powerful threats in the mid to late game, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer can quickly generate card advantage.

The main concept of this Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Colossus Hammer to create a high-powered threat capable of dealing massive damage in a single swing. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo pieces with Giver of Runes and Sigarda's Aid, as well as disruption with Thoughtseize. With the help of cards like Urza's Saga and Forge Anew, this deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off to overwhelm the opponent and secure the win.

The main focus of the deck is to play aggressively with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain tempo by controlling the board with counterspells, all while keeping card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. This allows the deck to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize or set up their own win conditions.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to equip a huge creature, such as Inkmoth Nexus or Kaldra Compleat, with a powerful equipment to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. The deck utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces, while also including protection cards like Giver of Runes and Shadowspear. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a fast and lethal combo before they can respond effectively.

The key concept of this deck revolves around efficiently ramping up mana through cards like Azusa, Amulet of Vigor, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to quickly play Primeval Titan and search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Golgari Rot Farm with Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and trigger landfall abilities effectively. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Urza's Saga allows for consistent land drops and fetching key pieces for the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy using cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon to punish greedy mana bases and control decks. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide value by bringing back key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide a game-ending effect. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disruption to quickly overwhelm the opponent.
